title: Karl Compton recruits teenage Malmgren to MIT

tellings.quote: Two hours later, my father and said, "I want to take this boy out of your school. I want to come in September and metriculate in MIT

plain: In 1950, Karl Compton of MIT met a teenage Harold Malmgren at a mansion near Cambridge, Massachusetts, and after two hours told the boy's father he wanted to take him out of his school and have him start at MIT that September. Malmgren, who later became an advisor to presidents, tells Michels this about himself. It is the start of the career that, by his account, brought him into contact with UFO material.
